title: Semantic Audio Taxonomy & Availability Resolver
objective: Define and prove a provider-neutral semantic audio taxonomy and deterministic availability resolver over completed AAI-02 identities, AAI-03 capability evidence and AAI-04 nonblocking playback outcomes. It may select only an existing AAI-02 asset identity after deterministic semantic matching and independent fail-closed rights/capability/runtime checks; it never rewrites provider-native identities, silently prefers a provider, performs provider calls, acquires content, mutates gameplay owners or makes audio gameplay truth.

taxonomy.normalization_rule: Terms derive only from existing AAI-02 AudioIntent.semanticPath segments, AudioIntent.tags and AudioAsset.semanticTags; trim + lowercase, require [a-z0-9-]+, de-duplicate and sort. Existing identities are never rewritten.
taxonomy.match_rule: Every normalized required intent tag must exist in the normalized asset semanticTags; extra asset tags are permitted.
taxonomy.ranking_rule: Eligible candidates rank by descending semantic coverage then stable assetId ascending. Provider identity is never a ranking signal.
taxonomy.unknown_rule: Missing, empty, invalid or malformed semantic evidence fails closed.

availability.rights_rule: Asset and source AAI-02 play rights must both be exactly allowed; denied, unknown and not-applicable fail closed.
availability.capability_rule: Provider-controlled/external candidates consume AAI-03 capability negotiation; only selectable outcomes may be available. Manual external reference remains manual.
availability.local_rule: User-owned local candidates require usable AAI-03 local-file-access plus explicit supported caller runtime-media probe.
availability.reference_rule: Candidate identities must resolve through AAI-02 exactly; missing references fail closed and no live catalog search occurs.
availability.independence_rule: Semantic compatibility, AAI-02 provenance/rights, AAI-03 capability and runtime availability remain independent evidence dimensions.

cue_and_playback.rule: Only unresolved cues carrying an existing intentId are resolved. Manual-reference remains manual; silent remains silent. Receipt selects an existing assetId or null without mutating the cue; AAI-04 nonblocking outcomes remain binding.

identity_and_owners.rule: AAI-02 identities are consumed, never rewritten. World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners remain canonical and resolver output is presentation/support state only.

persistence.result: No durable persistence is required; resolver outputs are deterministic derived/runtime values.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..05 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
semantic compatibility, AAI-02 rights/provenance, AAI-03 capability and caller runtime availability remain independent and fail closed
AAI-04 playback/layer/mixer behavior and nonblocking outcomes remain binding
no provider/catalog is canonical and provider identity is never an implicit semantic preference
unsupported operations cannot be emulated by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited copying
AAI-06 is selected_not_started only until a future governed start

no provider authentication/live catalog/provider calls/acquisition/download/copying/caching/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation was authorized or performed
next_action: Closed. AAI-05 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. AAI-06 is selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads and resolve its bounded import/link and initial-provider-adapter contract before implementation begins.
